requirement: Tracy CI Turbo: the plan job and the rows compute the same task hashes, and a suite read outside its task's inputs turns turbo-config red

oracle.ref: PR #1289 (fix); fix evidence: 12/10/2026: 12 Tracy CI runs on pull requests into develop logged 'turbo-cached: 0 of 47 test tasks are in the remote cache' while their rows were served from it (run 38316914525, tests packages: 27 of 39 cached); on one machine and one commit a clean checkout and a bootstrapped one differed in 47 of 47 task hashes (no dsh submodule), then in 2 of 47 (vendor/tracy/dsh-passwords/dist/client.js). Appending a line to .github/workflows/tracy-ci.yml or deploy/.env.example changed 0 of 47 hashes although 14 files under scripts/test read them: the read tracer wrapped fs.<name> without synchronising the named ESM exports.
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0'. Tracer: a file read through a named import (import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs') under a real node --test run is in the trace; so are the reads of a child killed before it could exit, and the repository paths on the command line of a child the tracer cannot enter (a program that is not node, or a node child given its own env, which the tracer leaves untouched). Generator: a command that does not start, exits non-zero, runs past its limit, leaves no trace or a trace without its test files is refused; a read outside the inputs, a hashed file git ignores and a task Turbo does not list are problems for root, package, interop and vendor tasks; a read of a file git ignores passes only when GENERATED declares it and every declared source is an input of the task, and a read of git's own directory never passes. Real Turbo on a fixture repository carrying the real root turbo.json: an edit of .github/workflows/tracy-ci.yml or deploy/.env.example changes the hash of //#test:ci:scripts; a tree with node_modules, .turbo logs and vendor/tracy/dsh-passwords/dist (what a bootstrapped row has) hashes every task as the clean tree does; a source, build script or package.json of dsh-passwords still changes the hash; a tree without the dsh submodule hashes every task differently and its dry run is refused. Comparison: equal hashes pass; a different hash, a missing task, an unknown task or another commit are red; a different cache answer is reported and is not a failure; a row's record is evidence only when it holds exactly the tasks the row was scheduled, each once, each with HIT or MISS. Workflow: plan fetches the dsh submodule before the dry run, publishes TURBO_DRY on the last line after turbo-verify --plan, removes the deploy key with always(); the checks row compares every task hash and each Turbo row its own. Cacheable Turbo tasks run their suite once with input auditing; a red test or an uncovered read fails without producing a green cache entry. Cache hits skip both; changing the auditor invalidates the result. Release and fallback retain full audits.
